control.feedback: fixed guitar-local wrist origin and xyzw orientation; arm12 only; no pad error
control.target_bounds: actual controller action bounds; accumulated correction clamped without windup
control.requested_target_rate: existing per-axis controller rate, arm3rad/s; native alpha0.2 remains
control.reset: reset only affected teacher rows; no physics step; first native-reset tick skips feedback
control.limitation: finite feedback target request; actual pose or3s arrival not guaranteed
